mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 90.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 225.0 (index 1982-1984=100) over a 3-month period triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 in a single month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS falls below 130,000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a dual contraction in supply and labor markets, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 8.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
